## Per-item results

**1. UV panel into the focus panel (req_2643 OO) — LANDED.** The floating UV ATLAS viewport card is **removed** (ModelView.tsx ~2050, replaced by a pointer comment); `showUv` state and the "UV" re-open pill are gone. The relocated UV section renders in the MODEL FOCUS branch of Inspector.tsx:101-135 (`UvSection`), placed below the OUTLINER (spec allowed above-or-below; below keeps a tall preview from crowding the part list out of the non-scrolling body). Header row = title + `658×1007 · 327 x/m`-style readout + a tiny refresh verb (`HW_MiniVerb`, fallback only — `refreshUvIfLive` off adoptMesh/applyTopo/stroke-end is untouched, ModelView.tsx:833). Preview scales to `REGIONS.focusPanel.innerWidth - 24`, height-bounded at 170 (Inspector.tsx:40-41). Honest-empty row ("atlas: none — created on first Paint") until the first atlas exists.

**2. Per-part UV scoping, first slice (req_2619 P) — partial by design, host gap reported.** The header labels with the ACTIVE outliner part ("UV · CUBE 1", from `state.modelParts` + `modelActivePartId`, Inspector.tsx:305-310). Island filtering to the part's face range is **blocked cart-side**: `framework/gpu/paint_islands.zig:33` carries `Island.group` (the authored group id), but `hostModelAtlasRead` (framework/v8_bindings_core.zig:1322-1331) serializes only `x,y,w,h` per island — no group ids, so face→island-rect mapping never reaches the cart. **Exact host edit needed:** emit each island's `group` in the `__model_atlas_read` islands array (5-tuple `group,x,y,w,h` or a parallel `groups` array) — the data is already on the struct in that loop. Until then the panel shows the whole-model view with an honest `scope: whole model` readout.

**3. Loop-cut popup compaction (req_2643 MM) — LANDED.** Direction is a two-state toggle pair labeled by axis with real spans ("U 1.0u | V 1.0u"), same treatment as [Size | %] (ModelView.tsx ~1830). Card width is the sum of its REGIONS.grid columns (`LC_CARD_W` = pad + labelWidth 82 + gap + stepBtn/valueWidth/stepBtn zone = 204px, ModelView.tsx:434-445); cuts/offset steppers + unit toggle + Apply all end on one right edge; bottom-center clamp wrapper unchanged.

**4. Create Paint Atlas grid (req_2643 NN) — LANDED.** Size rows on fixed columns: size label (68), density (88), recommended-chip column (76, ALWAYS reserved — empty for non-recommended rows), bytes right-aligned to the one right edge; all cells `numberOfLines={1} noWrap`. TYPE buttons equal width via `flexGrow:1, flexBasis:0, minWidth:0`. The z-order `overflow:'hidden'` wrapper from 81309f7b0 is untouched.

**5. SHAPE readouts (req_2618 G) — LANDED.** `ShapeSection` (Inspector.tsx:55-91): verts/faces/edges/uv'd/mounts on one `HW_StatGrid` row + bounds center/radius rows. All real: verts/edges from `__mesh_edit_counts` (read '—' until the host builds topology — never 0-faked), faces = authored faces (kept true through `appendPart` — the appended grouping is cart-side, ModelView.tsx:959-963), uv'd = faces-with-atlas (whole-model atlas covers all once created, 0 before), mounts honest 0, center computed one-pass from load vertices (`meshBoundsCenter`, ModelView.tsx:227-246; '—' for file imports whose vertices never cross the bridge), radius from the host load.

## Bridge shape
`globalThis.__modelFocusBridge` = `{ uv, paintLive, refreshUv(), shape }` + `__modelFocusBridgeChanged` ping — exported types `ModelFocusUv/ModelFocusShape/ModelFocusBridge` in ModelView.tsx:88-107, published by an effect (ModelView.tsx:1113-1142), retracted on unmount; Inspector subscribes via `useModelFocusBridge` (Inspector.tsx:28-35). Type-only import Inspector→ModelView (erased at bundle). Zero AppFrame/types.ts edits. Blocking gate (`ModelToolSnapshot.blocking`) untouched.

- `RJIT_MODELDOC=cube RJIT_MESHOPS="mode:3;sel:2;lcbegin;lcprev:0,3,0.5" ./tools/rjit shot editor` → `scratchpad/lc_compact.png`: compact card, U selected, one right edge. Same with `lcprev:1,4,0.35` → `lc_dirV.png`: **V** toggle lit, cuts 4, offset u 0.35, live topo counts (72 verts / 194 edges) in SHAPE.
- `RJIT_EDKEYS="p"` → `atlas_dialog.png`: size picker columns aligned, recommended chip only on 1024² without blowing the row, bytes right-aligned, TYPE buttons equal, dialog above the scene.
- `RJIT_MESHOPS="addpart:cube;parts"` → `focus_uv_shape2.png`: SHAPE reads **12 faces** after add (6+6), bounds `0.00, 0.50, 0.00 u` / `0.87 u` on grid rows, header **UV · CUBE 1** (active part, not the model name), no wrapped labels. (Active-part *switching* isn't headlessly drivable — outliner selection is a click; header source is `modelActivePartId` so it tracks by construction.)
